summary: Phase-4 Iteration-4 testing completed. All 26 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tests passed. A) POST /api/phase4/admin/release-gate/override: BLOCKED durumda çalışıyor (non-BLOCKED 400 döndürür), reason_note<12 için 400, invalid reason_code için 400. B) Override response alanları: override_id/admin_user_id/release_gate_snapshot/reason_code/reason_note/expires_at/revoked_at/deploy_context/used_deploy_count doğrulandı. C) POST /api/phase4/admin/release-gate/override/{id}/revoke çalışıyor (404 for nonexistent, 200 for existing). D) GET /api/phase4/admin/release-gate override_active/override_expires_at/override_id fields present, PASS_WITH_OVERRIDE status logic verified. E) Script /app/scripts/run_release_gate_check.sh exits 0 for PASS/PASS_WITH_OVERRIDE and exits 2 for BLOCKED. F) GET /api/exchange/readiness-checklist returns awaiting_valid_key/ready_for_test_order/blocked states with stale_after_minutes=10. G) POST /api/exchange/test-order returns 400 with detail.status when blocked (awaiting_valid_key). H) GET /api/phase4/admin/override-analytics returns days/points/alert_source_breakdown. I) GET /api/phase4/admin/alert-history returns alert list with created_at/action/severity/source/details fields. J) Admin /admin/monitoring UI verified: Release Gate Override Status panel, Override History, Hardening Checklist Trend, Alert History, 7/30 toggle. K) User /user/exchange-settings UI verified: readiness checklist card, awaiting_valid_key banner, failure banner, action state machine (validating/ready/blocked/executing), test-order result card.
